Ten persons, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N and P, sit in a straight row, not necessarily in the same order. Some of them face north while the others face south. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. K sits to the immediate left of J.
2. Only two persons sit between H and L when counted from the left of H.
3. M sits to the immediate right of P.
4. Neither N nor G is an immediate neighbour of M.
5. K sits second to the left of L, who faces south.
6. H and P face opposite directions.
7. The one who sits second to the left of K faces north.
8. L sits fourth to the right of N.
9. F sits second to the left of E, who faces south.
10. P sits second to the left of the one who sits to the immediate left of M.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits to the immediate left of J?

steps: Start with clue 5: it fixes K and L.
Clue 1 gives 2 cases — Case 1: J placed and J faces south; Case 2: J placed, H faces south and J faces north.
Clue 2 splits Case 1 into 2 cases — Case 1a: H third to the right of L and H faces south; Case 1b: H third to the left of L and H faces north.
Clue 8 splits Case 1a into 2 cases — Case 1aa: N fourth to the right of L and N faces north; Case 1ab: N fourth to the left of L and N faces south.
Clue 8 splits Case 1b into 2 cases — Case 1ba: N fourth to the right of L and N faces north; Case 1bb: N fourth to the left of L and N faces south.
Clue 8 splits Case 2 into 2 cases — Case 2a: N fourth to the right of L and N faces north; Case 2b: N fourth to the left of L and N faces south.
Clue 7 splits Case 1aa into 2 cases — Case 1aaa: E faces south and K faces south; Case 1aab: K faces south.
Clue 7 splits Case 1ba into 2 cases — Case 1baa: E faces south and K faces south; Case 1bab: K faces south.
Clue 7 splits Case 2a into 2 cases — Case 2aa: E faces south and K faces south; Case 2ab: E faces south and K faces south.

Clue 9 splits Case 1bab into 2 cases — Case 1baba: E in seat 1 from the west end, F in seat 3 from the west end, E faces south and F faces south; Case 1babb: E in seat 3 from the west end, F in seat 5 from the west end and E faces south.
Clue 10 cannot be met in Case 1baa, Case 1babb, Case 2aa and Case 2ab, so they are rejected.
Clues 10 and 3 then place M and P.
Clue 6 rules out Case 1aaa — only Case 1baba survives.
Clue 4 then places G.
Final arrangement (west to east): E [south], N [north], F [south], M [north], P [south], L [south], J [south], K [south], H [north], G [north].
J faces south, so J's right is towards the west end.
Immediately to the left of J: K — answer **K**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
solution.trap: L is immediately to the right — counting in the wrong direction gives this option.
